name: celltypepilot
description: Single-cell annotation review plugin — evidence-based candidate labels, conservative abstention, and rules-based critic checks.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable single-cell annotation review with conservative abstention
interface.longDescription: CellTypePilot is a local-first annotation review plugin for pre-clustered single-cell data. It produces evidence-backed candidate labels, abstains when evidence is insufficient, runs rules-based critic checks, and writes reviewable figures, reports, and provenance artifacts. Outputs are drafts requiring qualified human adjudication; the critic is not an independent biological replicate.
